turns.q: What are the best things to do in Hanoi in 2 days?
turns.head:
For two full days, focus on Hoàn Kiếm and the Old Quarter on day one, then Ba Đình and Văn Miếu on day two. I’ve favoured quieter evening options over the noisier beer-street scene.
